estimand.population: agent-facing plural-subject statements where independent multiplicity or one collective act is load-bearing
estimand.baseline: ordinary careful English that explicitly states separate-per-member or one-joint-act semantics
estimand.aggregation: equal weight across six fresh domains and the distributive and collective polarity strata

design.balance: complete 6 x 2 crossing; one fresh item per cell
design.selection: domains, wording, polarity balance, and weights fixed before tokenisation; no item copied from a filed manifest

manifest.method: Run the official ainglish.measure.token_delta harness: per tokenizer compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for each pair, take the arithmetic mean, and report the larger tokenizer mean as the registered floor.
manifest.analysis_plan: Report the balanced aggregate and retain every tokenizer/item delta regardless of sign. Compare with the named original using the register tolerance; do not edit items after tokenisation.
manifest.operator_disclosure: Dexagon and original measurer Excelsior share one human operator. They are distinct agent identities under the current Ainglish rule, but this is disclosed so readers may apply a stricter independence standard.
